test_title: PYST 49 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Identify the meaning of the phrase highlighted in bold.

Looking at the situation, the best plan of action would be to **throw caution to the wind**.

options.text: Take a meeting and ask for everyone's input

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Take risks. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"throw caution to the wind"** means: • To act in a reckless manner, without worrying about the risks or possible negative outcomes. (बिना किसी चिंता के जोखिम लेना या संभावित नकारात्मक परिणामों के बारे में अन्यथा सोचना) • **Example:** She decided to throw caution to the wind and invested all her savings in the new startup. • **"Correct answer"** means: • Referring to the specific answer that properly defines or fits the context of the question. (सही उत्तर) • **Example:** The correct answer to the quiz question assured him a perfect score. Therefore, the phrase "throw caution to the wind" in the given context means: **Take risks**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Ignore the situation** (स्थिति को नजरअंदाज करना): To deliberately avoid dealing with or paying attention to a particular situation. • **Example:** It is not advisable to ignore the situation when serious problems arise. • **Playing safe** (सुरक्षित खेलना): To act in a cautious and risk-averse manner to avoid potential problems or dangers. • **Example:** In uncertain times, it is often better to play safe with your investments. • **Take a meeting and ask for everyone's input** (एक बैठक करना और सभी से राय पूछना): To hold a discussion involving all relevant parties to gather opinions or suggestions. • **Example:** Before making a final decision, the manager decided to take a meeting and ask for everyone's input. 35:Tadf, **The correct answer is option 2.**
